claims.description: tokenize produces position-carrying tokens: every token records the 1-based line and col of its first character, and token types/values match DESIGN.md section 2 exactly
string literals decode exactly the escapes \" \\ \n \t; an unterminated string raises WeftError at the opening quote and an unknown escape raises WeftError at the backslash
comments from ; to end of line produce no tokens and do not disturb the line/col positions of surrounding tokens

Tests in tests/lexer.test.mjs must pin token types, values, and exact 1-based line/col positions across multi-line input.

Extend src/lexer.mjs (read it first; modify, do not rewrite unrelated parts) with double-quoted string literals per DESIGN.md section 2: decode escapes \" \\ \n \t, token type 'str' positioned at the opening quote; unterminated string and unknown escape raise WeftError with the exact positions and message prefixes the spec names. Tests in tests/lexer-strings.test.mjs.

Extend src/lexer.mjs with ; comments per DESIGN.md section 1: everything from ; to end of line is skipped, producing no tokens, while line/col accounting for subsequent tokens stays exact (pin a case where a comment sits between tokens on one line and a case with full-line comments). Tests in tests/lexer-comments.test.mjs.
